1.text: From the first he was the Word, and the Word was in relation with God and was God.
And I saw a new heaven and a new earth: for the first heaven and the first earth were gone; and there was no more sea.

2.text: And I saw the holy town, new Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, like a bride made beautiful for her husband.

3.text: And there came to my ears a great voice out of the high seat, saying, See, the Tent of God is with men, and he will make his living-place with them, and they will be his people, and God himself will be with them, and be their God.

4.text: And he will put an end to all their weeping; and there will be no more death, or sorrow, or crying, or pain; for the first things have come to an end.

5.text: And he who is seated on the high seat said, See, I make all things new. And he said, Put it in the book; for these words are certain and true.

16.text: For which cause we do not give way to weariness; but though our outer man is getting feebler, our inner man is made new day by day.

17.text: For our present trouble, which is only for a short time, is working out for us a much greater weight of glory;

18.text: While our minds are not on the things which are seen, but on the things which are not seen: for the things which are seen are for a time; but the things which are not seen are eternal.

4.text: But the wise took oil in their vessels with their lights.

46.text: And these will go away into eternal punishment; but the upright into eternal life.

1.text: For this reason, holy brothers, marked out to have a part in heaven, give thought to Jesus the representative and high priest of our faith;

12.text: My brothers, take care that there is not by chance in any one of you an evil heart without belief, turning away from the living God:

13.text: But give comfort to one another every day as long as it is still Today; so that no one among you may be made hard by the deceit of sin:

14.text: For if we keep the substance of the faith which we had at the start, even till the end, we have a part with Christ;

15.text: As it is said, Today if you will let his voice come to your ears, be not hard of heart, as when you made him angry.
